about_the_game:
The Perfect Desktop Companion

Transform your desktop into a living, breathing universe. Pocket Universe can be run as a transparent overlay that sits beautifully on your screen, allowing you to work, study, or relax while watching stunning procedurally generated star systems. Position it anywhere on your desktop for a personalized experience.

Active & Passive Gameplay

Idle Exploration: Click on distant planets and let your ship automatically navigate while you focus on other tasks. The transparent interface ensures your cosmic journey never interrupts your workflow. Perfect for background ambiance during work sessions or study time.

Interactive Travel: Take control when you want more engagement. Pilot your ship through asteroid fields and ride solar winds to reach your destination faster.

Planet Catalogue

Discover and collect over 100 unique planets to build your personal catalog. Create custom planets by applying your own textures, then watch as they seamlessly integrate into future explorations alongside the procedurally generated universe.

Build your OWN Star System

Build personalized star systems using your discovered and created planets. Choose planets and stars, arrange cosmic bodies with custom sizes, add rings or satellites to create your own perfect stellar neighborhood.

Transform your desktop into a living cosmic experience. Pocket Universe runs as a transparent overlay anywhere on your screen, creating a stunning space backdrop while you work, study, or relax. Watch procedurally generated star systems come to life with glowing stars and drifting cosmic phenomena, turning your workspace into a personalized window to the universe.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 capable

short_description: A desktop overlay space exploration game where you travel through procedurally generated star systems, collect over 100 unique planets, and create custom universes while your ship journeys across the cosmos as a stunning transparent background on your screen.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish, Ukrainian
